items.title: From Indian Fields to Global Markets: Agri-Exports Gather Pace
items.summary: 20 NOV 2026 12:32PM by PIB Delhi India's agricultural exports recorded strong growth during April-September FY 2026-27, led by Basmati rice, processed frozen potatoes and yellow dent corn. Basmati rice exports increased 25.4%, while processed potato exports rose 20.8%. Yellow dent corn exports surged around 12-fold.

facts.text: Basmati Rice Exports Rise 25% to US$ 1.60 Billion Exports of Basmati rice increased around 25.4%, from US$ 1.28 billion during April–September FY 2025–26 to US$ 1.60 billion in the corresponding period of FY 2026–27.
Iran emerged as the largest destination among the reported markets, with exports increasing 44.1%, from US$ 129.8 million to US$ 187.1 million.
Saudi Arabia recorded growth of 7.9%, with exports rising from US$ 161.6 million to US$ 174.4 million.
The United States registered an increase of 27.7%, with shipments rising from US$ 109.5 million to US$ 139.8 million.

facts.text: In a post on social media, Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Shri Bhupender Yadav, stated that KOMG 3 is the first female cheetah from Botswana to give birth.
